notes: Identity verified against the row on five criteria across TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL SOURCES BELONGING TO DIFFERENT HOSPITAL GROUPS: (1) apollohospitals.com - three separate per-doctor pages (region/Hyderabad, corporate rheumatologist, city rheumatologist) naming him Rheumatologist at Apollo Hospitals SECUNDERABAD, Hyderabad, MBBS DNB(Gen Med) DM Rheumatology, 21 years; the branch is separately corroborated by Apollo's own online-doctors/best-rheumatologist-in-secunderabad-hyderabad page; (2) txhospitals.in - a per-doctor profile at an unrelated hospital group titling him Consultant Rheumatologist and giving the same qualification chain (MBBS Maharaja Institute of Medical Sciences Vizianagaram, DNB General Medicine NBE, DM Rheumatology) plus Indian Rheumatology Association membership. Name + specialty (Rheumatology) + hospital + branch (Secunderabad) + city all match the input row, hence High. The distinctive 'Ch' patronymic initial and the scarcity of rheumatologists in Hyderabad (Apollo's Banjara Hills listing shows just 2) make a same-name mix-up very unlikely; the two profiles are clearly one person, not two. TWO SUMMARY-ASSERTED CONTACT DETAILS WERE TESTED AND BOTH DISCARDED. (a) A summary offered 'Call 04069321004 to book an appointment' - REJECTED WITHOUT RECORDING: that is Apollo's central switchboard, already known in this project to have been mis-attributed as four different doctors' personal lines, and the brief forbids recording a hospital central booking line as a doctor's own. (b) A summary asserted a 'private clinic located at No-12, Banjara Hills, Sri Ram Nagar Col, Hyderabad-500028'. I ran the mandatory exact-phrase follow-up ('Revanth Chakravarthy' + 'Sri Ram Nagar' + Banjara Hills) and NO indexed page returned that clinic or address for him - the follow-up explicitly reported he practises at Apollo Secunderabad and returned nothing for the Sri Ram Nagar clinic. DISCARDED as unverified, and owns_clinic is therefore left FALSE despite the brief's note that rheumatologists often run their own clinic. The likely origin of the Banjara Hills association is innocent: TX Hospitals operates a Banjara Hills unit (per a Skedoc hospital page), so a hospital sitting was probably mis-rendered as a private clinic address. FLAGGED FOR A HUMAN: an experience conflict between the two official sources - Apollo says 21 years (agreeing with the row) while TX Hospitals says 12+ years and dates his MBBS to 2012, implying roughly 14. Also flagged: he appears to hold concurrent posts at Apollo Secunderabad AND TX Hospitals; this is dual affiliation rather than the stale-affiliation pattern, because the NAMED hospital does publish current per-doctor profiles for him, so hospital_profile is correctly populated rather than blanked. NO email, phone, appointment link, LinkedIn, personal website, ORCID, Google Scholar or ResearchGate was recorded - none appeared verbatim on any indexed page, and no apollo247.com per-doctor booking page exists for him (only Apollo's locality-level rheumatologist listings). A JustDial listing surfaced twice and was rejected outright as a call-tracking proxy. Skedoc, MediBuddy and HexaHealth are corroborating-only and were not counted toward the band.
